label: Peplink Balance 380
description: Load-balancing router: 3x GE WAN, 3x GE LAN, 1 Gbps routing throughput.
notes: Vendor figures from the Peplink tech-spec sheet: Ethernet WAN port 3 (GE), Number of Ethernet LAN port 3 (GE), Router Throughput 1 Gbps, Wi-Fi AP No, SFP LAN/WAN No. The **380 and 380X are the same port count with very different throughput** - 1 Gbps here against 3 Gbps there - so the letter on the end is the whole difference that matters.
